full_text:
Inc42's Post
Inc42
July 16 at 6:29 AM ·
AI hardware startup Aina has raised $5.5 Mn in a seed funding round co-led by Redstart Labs and 360 ONE Asset
Founded by former Ultrahuman VP of Hardware Apoorv Shankar, Aina has emerged from stealth to build an AI-native hardware interface designed to make interacting with AI more context-aware. The round also saw participation from MIXI Global Investments, Antler and Blume Founders Fund, along with several angel investors.
The startup will use the fresh capital to bring its flagship product to market, expand its engineering and product teams, and scale operations across Bengaluru and San Francisco.
To read the article in detail, click here: https://4-2.co/4w9nGFd
